Connor (Eng): Hey folks, quick benefits question before I exit in two weeks: can I roll my 401k and also move my HSA balance? Also wondering about beneficiary forms.
Ayesha (People Ops): Congrats on the new role! :tada: Short answers: yes you can roll your 401k after separation, HSAs are yours to keep and can be transferred, and you should double-check beneficiary elections before you leave.
Connor (Eng): For HSA transfer, is there a vendor or is it held with the same company as the 401k?
Ayesha (People Ops): HSAs are separate. Our HSA custodian is HealthSave (https://portal.healthsave.example.com). If you want a trustee-to-trustee HSA transfer to a new HSA provider, request a transfer form from HealthSave. If you withdraw, watch tax/penalty rules.
Connor (Eng): And beneficiary changes? If I update after termination will my new employer's benefits override anything?
Drew (Finance): Beneficiary designations are attached to the account at the custodian. Changing them in HealthSave/Guideline is what matters. No overlap with your new employer unless you change new account's beneficiary later.
Connor (Eng): Okay. Any timing quirks for vested match and rollovers?
Ayesha (People Ops): Only vested employer contributions can be rolled. We'll confirm your vested balance on your separation date with Guideline. If you have an outstanding loan, that can be treated as a deemed distribution unless repaid.
Connor (Eng): I do have a small loan (~$2.1k). Can I arrange to repay from final pay?
Drew (Finance): Finance/payroll can set a one-time deduction if you sign off before cutoff. DM payroll with amount + employee ID. We'll aim to process before final check.
Connor (Eng): If I do a direct rollover to an IRA, any withholding?
Ayesha (People Ops): Direct trustee-to-trustee rollovers are non-taxable and avoid the 20% mandatory withholding that applies to distributions made payable to you.
BenefitsBot: [system] Note: Guideline processing times vary; expect 7-14 business days for rollover requests to complete after vendor receives your election.
Connor (Eng): One more: do I need a separate beneficiary for HSA vs 401k?
Drew (Finance): Yes, they are separate accounts. Please check both portals and update if needed. If you pass away before distribution, beneficiaries receive according to each account's designation.
Ayesha (People Ops): Action items: Connor DM payroll with repayment amount if you want loan deducted; check Guideline for 401k beneficiary and HealthSave for HSA beneficiary; we'll notify Guideline of your termination date. We'll post confirmation here once done.
Connor (Eng): DMing payroll now. Thanks everyone! :pray:
